command:
set -eu
for part in tile attention; do
 if [ "$part" = tile ]; then src=qmm_group; else src=qwen35_kv8; fi
 /usr/local/cuda-13.3/bin/nvcc -fatbin -D__CUDA_NO_HALF_OPERATORS__ -D__CUDA_NO_HALF_CONVERSIONS__ -D__CUDA_NO_BFLOAT16_CONVERSIONS__ -D__CUDA_NO_HALF2_OPERATORS__ --expt-relaxed-constexpr -std c++20 -O3 -I$part/zig/kernels/cuda -gencode arch=compute_80,code=sm_80 -gencode arch=compute_86,code=sm_86 -gencode arch=compute_89,code=sm_89 -o limits/$src-older-13.3.fatbin $part/zig/kernels/cuda/$src.cu
done
